description: geo.rijkswaterstaat.nl: cycling and walking datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.rijkswaterstaat.nl. Coverage: the area served by geo.rijkswaterstaat.nl. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about cycling and walking; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Loopareaal uitbreidingsgebieden voetpaden algemeen; Fietsareaal hoogwaardige fietsroute; Fietsareaal fietsnetwerken vrij; Fietsareaal nwb netwerk maart 2022. Formats seen: WFS, WMS, OGCFEAT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.nl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
